recommendations.description: Hardcoded API endpoint URL in todoService.ts must be moved to environment variables to support multiple deployment environments (dev/staging/production) and prevent accidental exposure of internal URLs.
Missing dependency in useEffect dependency array in useTodos.ts will cause stale closures and unexpected behavior. The fetchTodos function must be added to prevent infinite loops or missed updates.
Network error scenarios are not tested across service layer. Implement comprehensive error handling tests for fetch failures, timeouts, and validation errors to ensure production reliability.
Edit mode functionality and delete operations in TodoItem component lack comprehensive test coverage. Critical user interactions need edge case and state transition testing.
Race condition handling and concurrent mutation scenarios are not tested in useTodos hook. Need tests for rapid successive updates and optimistic update strategies.

Error handling across all files needs improvement. Implement custom error classes to distinguish between different failure types (network, validation, server errors) for better error recovery and user feedback.
Optimize event handlers and prevent unnecessary re-renders. Use useCallback in TodoItem component and implement request deduplication in todoService to improve app performance.
Extract complex conditional rendering logic from TodoItem into separate EditMode and ViewMode sub-components. This will improve testability and maintainability.
Implement useReducer pattern in useTodos hook for better state management. This will simplify complex state transitions and reduce bugs in async operations.
Add proper TypeScript interfaces and JSDoc comments for better documentation and IDE support. Focus on public APIs in service layer and component prop interfaces.
Add loading state to useTodos hook to allow UI to display appropriate feedback during async operations. Currently users have no indication when data is being fetched or operations are in progress.
